shortDescription: Brocade Fibre Channel security user configuration

options.name: delete_user_configs
options.description: List of user config data structure to be deleted

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: user_configs
options.description: List of user config data structure. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
